description: Complete email verification: pass the verificationId from vivid_identity_start and the 6-digit code the customer received. On success returns a short-lived identity token — pass that token to vivid_reorder / vivid_order_status to unlock the customer's private data. Codes expire in 10 minutes; attempts are limited.

code.description: the 6-digit code the customer received by email

name: vivid_identity_verify
